title: Consolidating Reasoning with Test-Time Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.02104v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective multi-agent collaboration requires finalizing solutions from reasoning that is distributed across the individual attempts of many agents. However, useful intermediate reasoning can remain unexploited when collaboration is limited to voting on conclusions reached among individual agents, or aggregating long, noisy collections of reasoning trajectories in context. In this work, we propose TTT-Consolidate, a framework that uses multi-agent reasoning trajectories as adaptation data to improve a model's subsequent reasoning. TTT-Consolidate jointly consolidates trajectories into parametric representations through test-time training, then generates a new solution by conditioning on the consolidated information. translated_title: 通过测试时训练整合推理
translated_abstract: 有效的多智能体协作需要从分布在多个智能体各自尝试中的推理过程里最终确定解决方案。然而，当协作仅限于对各个智能体得出的结论进行投票，或者在上下文中聚合冗长且充满噪声的推理轨迹集合时，有用的中间推理可能无法被充分利用。在这项工作中，我们提出了TTT-Consolidate，一个将多智能体推理轨迹作为适应数据来改进模型后续推理的框架。TTT-Consolidate通过测试时训练将轨迹联合整合为参数化表示，然后基于整合后的信息生成新的解决方案。我们在训练阶段使用双层优化来元学习如何进行整合，其中内循环将推理轨迹编码到轻量级的LoRA适配器中，外循环则学习内循环的元参数……
tldr: 该论文提出TTT-Consolidate框架，利用测试时训练将多智能体协作中产生的推理轨迹整合为参数化表示，从而改进模型后续的推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TTT-Consolidate, a framework that uses test-time training to consolidate multi-agent reasoning trajectories into parametric representations, thereby improving the model's subsequent reasoning.
